title: Lists read an inline copy of the document keys
why: Every filter, sort, count, facet and aggregate opened each stored document from TOAST storage; a home list read 75,024 buffers.
changelog: backend lists filter, sort, count, facet and aggregate on `query_keys`, an inline generated copy of each document's keys, instead of opening every stored document; run `brain backend migrate` before serving this version, which refuses a database without that column with `BDB_SCHEMA_DRIFT`
